title: ConditionReport
description: The state of a vehicle as recorded by whoever was physically present, at each point the vehicle changes hands. Comparing two reports written at different stages by different organisations is what removes damage disputes, and what lets a coordinator stand behind work it did not witness. Held in the vehicle eVault, so the reports accumulate into that one condition history no matter who wrote them. Attribution comes from recordedByEName and the acknowledgement signature, not from where the record is stored.

vehicleEName.description: eName of the vehicle the report describes

incidentEnvelopeId.description: Absent for reports written outside an incident, such as a replacement-vehicle handover or a planned maintenance collection

jobEnvelopeId.description: The recovery, transport, repair or mobility job this report was written under

stage.description: Which point in the chain this report was taken at. Comparing stages is the whole mechanism, so the vocabulary is fixed.

recordedByEName.description: eName of the named person who was present

recordedByOrgEName.description: eName of the organisation the recording person works for

address.description: Street address of the inspection, as a person would write it

media.description: Photographs and video, each with the moment it was taken

kind.description: Whether the file is a photograph or a video

takenAt.description: When the photograph or video was taken

area.description: The damage area it shows, using the same names as damage[].area

damage.description: One entry per panel or area. Area names are the shared vocabulary that makes two reports comparable.

area.description: The panel or area, from the fixed list every report uses

severity.description: How bad the damage to this area is. none records that the area was checked and found undamaged.

note.description: Description of the damage for people

mediaUris.description: w3ds://file URIs of the photographs or videos that show this damage

fuelOrChargeLevel.description: Percentage, whichever of fuel or charge applies to the drivetrain

contents.description: Personal belongings and loose items left in the vehicle

keysHandedOver.description: Whether the keys were handed over with the vehicle at this point

acknowledgement.description: The receiving party, or the driver, confirming the report. A two-sided record before the vehicle is taken away.

byEName.description: eName of the person confirming the report

signature.description: The person's signature from their eID wallet, made through w3ds://sign

declined.description: True when the person refused to confirm, for example because they dispute the damage recorded

declineReason.description: Why the person refused to confirm

createdAt.description: When the record was first written

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed

revision.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change to the record
